shortDescription: France's Vivendi EURONEXT:VIV said on Thursday the value of its investment portfolio fell to 5.12 billion euros ($5.95 billion) as of June 30, from 5.88 billion euros at the end of 2025. Net debt amounted to 1.59 billion euros as of June 30, while first-half revenue fell 3.5% to 140 million euros…
